messages:
Ava Patel: Quick heads-up — we have the launch preview dress rehearsal tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Plan: reg page -> Zoom run-through -> recording -> clip extraction -> post-event email + lead routing. Can we do a final checklist and owners? Staging reg page: https://staging.redwood.com/preview-reg :eyes:

Jon Chen: I can own Zoom setup. Quick checklist from my side:
- Zoom meeting scheduled, host = Ava, co-host = Jon
- Enable 'Record to the Cloud' + Auto-transcribe
- Disable waiting room (we're expecting many interns) but enable passcode
- Add alternative host (maya@redwood.com)
- Turn on 'Allow participants to unmute' for demo segment

Small settings snippet for copy paste:
```
Recording: Cloud
Auto-Transcription: ON
Waiting Room: OFF
Passcode: auto-generated
Alternative Host: maya@redwood.com
```

Maya Rivera: I'll take post-event clip extraction and HubSpot routing. Plan: pull cloud recording, generate 3x clips (highlights, full replay, 3-min teaser), auto-generate captions (SRT) and attach to assets. Tag leads with: preview_interest=true, event=launch_preview

Samir Gupta: I'll own the follow-up email & nurture sequence. Draft flow: immediate thank-you email with replay + CTA to get early access, 24h reminder for no-shows, 7-day nurture with benchmark narrative whitepaper. Need HubSpot list mapping (Maya to confirm).

Ops: For resilience — set RTMP fallback to our backup stream. Stream key stored in 1Password: redwood/streams/preview. Also recommend local recording on laptop as backup (host). If cloud upload fails Recording Bot will post a failure alert.

Recording Bot: Reminder scheduled — will post "Recording started" at 10:05 AM PT and upload link when processing completes. If processing fails, will ping #eng-ops.

Ava Patel: Sweet — owners confirmed: Jon = Zoom + live ops, Maya = clips + tagging, Samir = emails + nurture, Ops = stream fallback. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if good? Also final ask: marketing needs 2 hero images from design by EOD today for social promos.

Jon Chen: :thumbsup: I'll also add a short run-of-show doc to the reg page (linking in the event notes).

Maya Rivera: :thumbsup: Will post HubSpot mapping in this thread by 3 PM.

Samir Gupta: :thumbsup: Draft email going up in HubSpot test list after the run-through.

Ops: :thumbsup: I validated RTMP credentials and added the local-record checklist to the runbook.

Ava Patel: Perfect — thanks team. See you at the run-through 10:00 AM PT. If anything changes ping me directly.
